rationale: Reviewed commit 446900446205ebac7c5c35fb26ef7c5f29c05cc6 fixes the round-1 chain-loss defect: bdRenderedError renders escaped text while Unwrap returns the original error, and every changed production site embeds it with %w. All four committed chain-regression tests pass, including BeadExists with non-empty stderr, QueryReady errors.As recovery, the FetchBeadAsOf production IsUnsupportedFlagError classification, and direct wrapper identity. The whitespace-only table exactly covers the four cases named in my prior review and all cases pass. The affected package suites pass and the bead worktree remains clean at the reviewed SHA. My round-1 test request literally named both QueryReady and QueryReadyForEpic; only QueryReady has a dedicated chain test, so that narrow test-coverage portion is PARTIAL, but QueryReadyForEpic visibly uses the identical chain-preserving wrapper and this is not a spec-branch-corrupting defect. The brief assigns G3 deferral adjudication to R3, so I do not reopen it.

findings.summary: The four chain-regression tests pass: TestBeadExists_NotFoundWithNonEmptyStderr, TestBdRenderedError_UnwrapExposesUnderlyingError, TestQueryReady_ErrorsAsReachesExitError, and TestFetchBeadAsOf_IsUnsupportedFlagErrorClassifiesThroughWrapper.

The wrapper contract is directly pinned and verified: bdRenderedError.Unwrap returns the exact underlying error object, while Error returns safely escaped text; outer callers preserve this chain with %w.

My round-1 wording requested dedicated errors.As coverage for both QueryReady and QueryReadyForEpic. The committed suite directly covers QueryReady but not QueryReadyForEpic. The latter production site nevertheless uses the same fmt.Errorf(... %w, &bdRenderedError{err: err}) construction, so this is a non-blocking test-specific omission rather than a demonstrated runtime defect.

TestWrapBDError_WhitespaceOnlyStderrPassesThrough contains and passes the exact named cases: empty, spaces-and-tabs, LF-only, and CRLF-only; each remains the bare exit error and preserves errors.As classification.

Focused regressions and full internal/bead plus internal/next package tests pass. HEAD is exactly 446900446205ebac7c5c35fb26ef7c5f29c05cc6, with no tracked, staged, or untracked bead-worktree changes after testing.
